attr.title: Fancy Pants Adventures: Classic Pack
attr.desc: The Fancy Pants Adventures World 1, World 2 and World 3 and the World 4 hub from the Classic Pack, running in the Ruffle Flash emulator.
attr.inst: Buy the game on Steam and copy everything from its install folder into ports/fancypants/gamedata/. The first launch patches the game files and converts the World 4 textures, which takes a few minutes.
attr.inst_md: Buy the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1668460/) and copy everything from its install folder into `ports/fancypants/gamedata/`. The first launch patches the game files and converts the World 4 textures, which takes a few minutes.
